headline: Australian Housing Market Sees Record Price Drops as Regional Boom Moderates
summary: Australia experienced a record drop in national home prices as urban buyer relocation to regional housing markets slowed down, threatening to end post-pandemic property gains.
why: Residential real estate forms the core of Australian household wealth and mortgage exposure across major domestic commercial banks.

impacts.name: Australian Real Estate
impacts.why: Weakening regional demand and falling home valuations lower residential property wealth and construction activity.
